meta.title: Budget Management page shows Budget Department List and Budget Update Request List tabs

args.goal: Navigate to Budget Management from the left-side navigation, open the Budget Department List and Budget Update Request List tabs, and leave the page showing the tab interface and Budget Department List columns.

steps.note: Performs the unavailable Budget Management navigation and tab interaction in the buyer session.
Confirms the required Budget Department List tab is present.
Confirms the required Budget Update Request List tab is present.
Confirms the Budget Department List includes the status column.
Confirms the Budget Department List includes the period type column.
Confirms the Budget Department List includes the fiscal year range column.
Confirms the Budget Department List includes the allocated budget column.
Confirms the Budget Department List includes the spent budget column.
Confirms the Budget Department List includes the participant teams column.
